combined: Analyze the current ARC3 state and return exactly one strict JSON object with keys new_identities, objects_pl, differences_pl, similarities_pl, turtle_from_image_pl, turtle_from_diff_pl, and rules_pl. Every *_pl value must be plain SWI-Prolog source without Markdown fences. Use object_registry.pl as the canonical identity source and reuse friendly IDs exactly. new_identities must contain only genuinely new objects as objects with id, type, and label fields. Never use opaque IDs such as obj_1. Track semantic objects and useful block structures: contiguous blobs, rectangles, bars, lines, holes, enclosures, sub-objects, and compound objects. objects_pl contains state-specific facts and turtle_program/2 facts, not repeated object_identity/3 declarations. differences_pl records direct parent-to-current evidence. similarities_pl records object correspondences. turtle_from_image_pl redraws the current frame. turtle_from_diff_pl patches parent to current. rules_pl separates observed_rule/2, hypothetical_rule/3, evidence/3, supported_by/2, and contradicted_by/2. At the level root, parent-dependent values may be empty strings.
